title: Meet the new Firezone logo
summary: Introducing a simpler, faster, and more recognizable logo for Firezone, plus a new brand kit for press and partners.
body_markdown:
You may have noticed something has changed around here recently.


We have a new logo.


### Why change it?


Our previous logo, introduced in[this fateful commit](https://github.com/firezone/firezone/commit/0c3bee4b8a988d9e555d51bbc321c0f3f3e68e61) from 2021 (by yours truly no less!), has served us well for the past five years. It was originally conceived as a hybrid between a phoenix - a nod to the honorable[web framework](https://phoenixframework.org/) that powers Firezone - and a flame, which I thought fitting given the company name.


However, it doesn't display well at small sizes (RIP favicon), and to be honest, was always a bit more complex than we wanted it to be.


As Firezone grew, the gap between that logo and the product we are building became more obvious. Firezone makes secure access fast and simple. Our identity should feel the same way.


### Simple and fast


The new mark is intentionally simpler, with a sense of motion that reflects the speed of the product. We kept our signature orange so it still feels unmistakably Firezone.


More broadly, the new identity better reflects the speed and simplicity we strive for in the product, while supporting our mission to secure the world's information and restore global trust in internet-connected systems.


### Download the new logo


We have also launched a new[Firezone brand kit](https://www.firezone.dev/brand-kit) with official wordmarks, standalone marks, light and dark versions, our core color palette, and sensible-use guidance. Every logo is available as an SVG so it stays crisp at any size.


For press questions, permissions, or anything that is not covered in the brand kit, emailmedia@firezone.dev .
